why: ADVERSARIAL: 70% dirty, scattered, batch 4, on the densest operator in the set.

preprocessing.description: A `symmetric` Matrix Market file stores one triangle: each off-diagonal (i,j) contributes both (i,j) and (j,i); a diagonal entry contributes once. Stored values are used as-is; a `pattern` file gives 1.0.
preprocessing.duplicate_coordinates: none present; asserted at generation time

x0_description: x0[j][b] = 2u-1 where u = (SplitMix64(x0_seed).next() >> 11) * 2^-53, drawn in j-major then b order

dx.format: GVDX0001, little-endian; layout documented in README.md
dx.description: dx_v1: rng = SplitMix64(seed). k = max(1, round(dirty_fraction * cols)). A column set is drawn by repeatedly taking rng.next() mod cols and rejecting repeats, then sorting ascending. Step 0 draws such a set. motion=frozen keeps it; motion=scattered draws a fresh set every step; motion=drift replaces the r = max(1, round(drift_rho * k)) lowest-indexed members with freshly drawn columns not already retained, then re-sorts. Values are emitted per (position in the dirty set, batch lane), position major.

reference.summation_order: CSC. Columns ascending; within a column, row indices ascending; y[i*B+b] += A[i,j] * x[j*B+b] applied in exactly that sequence, with b ascending innermost. The delta apply uses the same order restricted to the dirty columns, taken ascending, and accumulates into the running y.

verification.exactness_argument: Tolerance grade. The bound is calibrated, not chosen: it is 10x the measured rel_l2 between two legitimate summation orders (CSC and row-major) on this exact case, floored at 1e-12. Any implementation whose result lands inside it agrees with the reference to within the spread that reordering alone produces.
